criteria.name: archetype_and_method

criteria.detail: PASS: Names the archetype (mature, capital-light staples/dividend payer) and states DCF as primary method with explicit justification (stable FCF history, not a bank/REIT/insurer), plus comps section justifies P/E and EV/EBITDA as appropriate secondary lens for this archetype.

criteria.name: unresolved_risk
